title: Spot the finding: remodelled tissue
intro: This lung specimen shows a third pattern. Locate the most conspicuous remodelling.

content.alt: Lung micrograph with irregular pale air spaces and broad areas of densely stained interstitial tissue.
content.prompt: Tap the area where thickened tissue most clearly replaces delicate alveolar walls.
content.explanation: The broad lower-left interstitium is expanded by cellular connective tissue rather than a delicate alveolar septum.

feedback.correct: The expanded cellular interstitium replaces the thin septa expected around open alveoli.
feedback.incorrect: Compare the broad stained tissue at lower left with the thin walls around the open spaces.
